dimensions.note: The ledger's 190 located entries (RAG-KAZ-E001 to E190) repeatedly name what changes Kazuya's response. Sudden family or peer scrutiny produces a blurted false claim before deliberation (E003, E005, E057). Attachment threat under ambiguity produces rapid rival theories, surveillance or catastrophic reading (E028, E035, E076, E127, E136, E162), and direct information from the person concerned produces apology and revision (E028, E137, E140-E141). The audience matters: he retreats when Chizuru herself tests his words but tells Sayuri plainly that he loves her (E042, E045). Time-limited crisis turns care into an explicit truth position (E061). When disclosure would expose Chizuru he chooses a protective bluff, and he surrenders it only under coercive proof pressure (E131-E132). The account predicts his mistakes and overreach as well as his restraint: reckless protection that shifts cost to others (E052, E079), a trivial avoidant lie (E165), sexualized gaze beside practical help (E174), and a protective lie that outlives his truth intentions (E134, E151). Not A: the rules this trace feeds (RAG-KAZ-R001 to R024) sit in a model that is not curated on the row, the ledger itself disclaims any universal response rule (Gaps), and its state summary stops at KAZ-S036. Not C: within V001-V040 the trace explains why his response changes with audience, stakes, available information and chronology, and states where that explanation stops.

Every entry carries a source state, from KAZ-S001 (displaced post-breakup client, V001) to KAZ-S040 (V038-V040 date preparation), and the state-change summary describes KAZ-S001 to S036 in prose. Located transitions include the V002 dive (E020), V003 private recognition of serious feeling (E022), the V004 Ruka trial (E026), the V012 film proposal (E065), the V021 explicit withdrawal from the trial (E109), the V026 exposure and near-complete family disclosure (E130-E134), the V027 three-month deterioration and recontact (E136-E138) and the V029 shared-house offer (E150). Not A: the prose summary ends at KAZ-S036 (V034) and the speech notes at V028, so V035-V040 rest on trace rows alone. Not C: the states are located, ordered and distinguish persistence from change across forty volumes.

The written-speech notes and speech columns give a pragmatic account of how he speaks and to whom: accusatory questions when humiliation is externalized, then a plain apology when his own responsibility is named (E002); stammering or blurting under sudden scrutiny, with his most consequential false claims arriving before deliberation (E003, E009); extreme self-description after conflict (E011); unusual directness when another person's dignity is at stake (E009); retreat under Chizuru's direct question against plain speech to third parties (E042, E045); and, late, plain status statements (E185) and the switch from 'Mizuhara' to 'Ichinose' (E187). Not B: the ledger is English paraphrase with almost no quotation and no Japanese text, so diction, first-person forms, politeness levels and verbal habits are unsupported. Not D: the pragmatic patterns are conditioned and located, not a scatter of remarks.

Ordinary conduct is sampled in recurring karaoke work and wages (E029, E033, E095), gift and booking planning (E050-E051), shared-house routine, shopping, small help and night errands (E152, E159-E160), the nursery promise (E164), cooking and bounded care (E169), games (E161, E167, E175) and route preparation (E179). The ledger itself records that ordinary repertoire was sparse through V007, that competence outside relationship crisis is underobserved, and that broad low-stakes duration remains sparse (speech notes; Gaps). Not B: most ordinary episodes are framed by his relationship with Chizuru and few are analyzed for habit or preference. Not D: V028-V040 supply a run of domestic and ordinary scenes with located conduct.

Conduct is differentiated by partner across many sampled relationships: Chizuru (paid access, privacy, support without status claims, E043, E048, E088, E099), Ruka (act-specific consent and refusal, explicit withdrawal, later concealment of the move and cohabitation, E049, E086, E103, E109, E188), Mami (lingering attachment, then apology and selective disclosure, E010, E118, E154, E185), Sumi (adaptive low-pressure support and receiving care, E037, E064), Kibe and Kuribayashi (defense, confession of his own deception, apology, E016, E034, E145), Mini (correction received, E137), Nagomi and Sayuri (family fiction, declaration to a family witness, E045, E124, E134) and the film crew (subordination to Tabuse's expertise, E078). Not A: the relationships are seen mostly from his side, Chizuru's answer is outside the boundary, and an acknowledged couple relationship is never sampled. Not C: the trace states how the same pressure produces different conduct with different partners.

Interior access is extensive and kept separate from speech and action: private recognition of feeling (E022), internal love with epistemic restraint (E100), self-scoring and anxious quantification (E167-E168), intrusive rival imagery marked as imagination (E127, E142, E176), and fear of having imposed (E182). The ledger repeatedly marks where his inference is not the other person's state (E098, E135, E157, E162). Not A: interior thought is reported as paraphrase, and the synthesized summary does not cover V035-V040. Not C: interior states are located and tied to subsequent conduct.

Sampled conflicts include the V001 review confrontation (accusation, then admission, E002), the fight with Kibe (E016), his argument for disclosure against Chizuru's refusal (E061), disputing her professional-failure account (E104), removing Ruka and rejecting her status claims (E119-E120), the V026 confrontation with Mami's coercive proof demand ending in surrender (E132), and receiving Kibe's punch and Kazuo's blow (E130, E134). Not B: the confrontation with Mami in V006 is performed by Chizuru rather than Kazuya (E040), his responses to the blows are not analyzed, and the ledger gives no account of how he escalates or de-escalates in open adversarial conflict beyond verbal dispute and surrender. Not D: the verbal-conflict pattern is conditioned and located across several partners.

Located reasoning includes the time-limited argument that continued lying is wrong (E061), sequencing the end of the Ruka trial before any confession as a matter of fairness (E108-E109), distinguishing a real wish for Chizuru's happiness from justification of the lie (E122), concluding that unqualified truth cannot protect Chizuru and choosing a protective bluff (E131), act-specific consent with Ruka and in the raft scene (E086, E103, E117), and noncontact support under terminal crisis (E089). Failures are located too: the residual dating lie is kept with Nagomi and Kibe (E134, E145, E151) and the move is hidden from Ruka (E188). Not A: the deciding weight between protecting Chizuru and correcting the family lie is shown only case by case. Not C: the evidence states what changes his ethical choice (time limits, exposure of Chizuru, coercive proof, act scope).

Play participation is recorded but not analyzed: comic panic (E035), Twister, ito and Bounce Off games (E161, E167, E175), kendama with nursery children (E164) and Joypolis activities (E183). No humor that he initiates, and no account of his playfulness, is recorded. Suitable only for bounded canon questions about which activities he joined. Not D: the play evidence is thin and mostly framed by anxiety about Chizuru.

The trace covers every volume from V001 to V040, in order, with evidence IDs routing to the project's deep readings, and the curated V021-V040 extension ends at V040 (E190). Not A: the front matter's source_boundary still says character evidence was inspected through V037 while the YAML block and entries run to V040; the prose summary and speech notes lag the trace; the series continues past V040 and V041+ is outside the boundary. Not C: within the declared boundary the coverage is continuous and located.

Every entry has a contradiction or limit column, and the ledger keeps affirmative counterevidence: recoil and refusal against Ruka's kisses and sexual pressure (E031, E049, E058, E060, E112), refusal to treat paid or emergency events as proof of reciprocity (E101, E135), misreadings corrected by direct information (E028, E156), and the Gaps section's statement that consensual intimacy in an acknowledged relationship is not represented. Not A: some limits are stated as gaps rather than tested counterexamples. Not C: the counterevidence is specific, located and used to bound claims.

Each entry names a KAZ-S state and volume-level evidence IDs (RAG-E-V001-001 to RAG-E-V040-012), and the discovery row places the endpoint at V040 image 0188 (May 17 Joypolis arrival). Within-volume order is preserved by the evidence-ID sequence. Not A: locators are evidence IDs routed to unenrolled readings, not page or image references in the ledger itself. Not C: states and their order are precise enough to split volumes at located changes.
